task: Clarify the portable Tool Advisor skill-to-agent workflow for Codex and Claude Code using host-native workers.

constraints.scope: Repository instruction and manual scenario updates only; no local-device installation, new runtime, changes to agent definitions or provider settings.

candidates.review_depth: Tool Advisor skill, execution and BUILD-FLOW source documents
candidates.fit: Selected skills and roles can be assigned to actual host workers without an extra runtime
candidates.overlap: Existing coordination and task tracking already covered; improve only the native invocation/loading boundary
prerequisites: Host exposes authorized native worker tools
Worker can load selected installed skill
candidates.costs: No added service required; execution/token costs depend on host and workload
uncertainties: Live Codex and Claude Code worker dispatch not tested in this session

candidates.review_depth: Architecture alternative, not an implemented candidate
candidates.fit: Not needed when host exposes supported agent tools
candidates.overlap: Would duplicate native worker execution and risk ownership conflicts
uncertainties: No prototype or benchmark was conducted

decision.status: Source policy update; no live runtime activation
decision.selected: Keep Tool Advisor as the sole coordinator, using native workers through the active host and explicit skill loading/invocation evidence.
actions: Preserve current discovery and confirmation policy
Make role-to-skill binding and native dispatch explicit
Verify worker skill access and invocation
Keep independent write ownership and acceptance verification
Use honest sequential fallback when no native workers
Do not build host-specific dispatch adapters or duplicate task trackers
deferred: New agent persona or blanket activation of all roles

review_passes.name: Architecture and ownership
review_passes.result: One coordinator; host-native delegation is already the intended mechanism; custom adapter duplicates it.

review_passes.name: Cross-host and safety compatibility
review_passes.result: Explicitly check real worker tools, skill loading, confirmation, ownership, tracking and fallback rather than assuming Codex and Claude behave identically.

evidence.checks: Text and policy consistency review; manual routing scenarios recorded.
unperformed: Live skill-loading proof in both hosts

feedback.text: The repository is intended to support Codex and Claude Code, not only one host.
Use native agent invocation from the current session instead of building a custom execution adapter.
Double-review the flow, then publish the update if sound.

revisit_when: A host's native agent/skill-loading interface changes
Live tests show failed or duplicated skill invocation
Cross-host setup expands beyond instruction portability
Native task tracking conflicts with advisor ledger
